entries.title: Report an Outage
entries.content: How do I report a power outage? You can report an outage by calling our contact center and selecting the "Report an Outage" option from the menu. What information do I need to report an outage? You may need: Your name, Service address, Account number (if available), Description of the issue. How can I check the status of a reported outage? You can check outage status through the automated system or speak with an agent for updates. How long will it take to restore power? Restoration times vary depending on the cause and severity of the outage. You will receive an estimated restoration time if available. Should I report an outage if my neighbors also have no power? Yes. Even if neighbors are affected, reporting helps us confirm the scope of the outage. What should I do during a power outage? Turn off major appliances, Keep refrigerator/freezer doors closed, Avoid downed power lines, Report the outage immediately. How do I report a downed power line? Stay away and call immediately to report it as an emergency.

entries.title: Move or Disconnect Service
entries.content: How do I transfer my electricity service to a new address? Contact us and select the "Move Service" option. Provide your current and new service address. How far in advance should I request a move? We recommend contacting us at least 3–5 business days before your move date. How do I disconnect my electricity service? Call the contact center and select "Disconnect Service." Provide your account and disconnection date. Is there a fee for moving or disconnecting service? Fees may apply depending on your service agreement. Can I schedule a same-day disconnection? Same-day requests depend on availability and service policies. What happens to my deposit when I disconnect service? Your deposit (if applicable) may be refunded after your final bill is processed.

entries.title: New Connection
entries.content: How do I request a new electricity connection? Call the contact center and select "New Connection." Provide your personal and property details. What documents are required for a new connection? You may need: Valid ID, Proof of property ownership or lease agreement, Contact details. How long does it take to activate a new connection? Activation times vary but are typically completed within a few business days. Is a security deposit required for a new connection? A deposit may be required depending on credit history and service policies. Can I apply for a new connection online? If online services are available, you may submit your request digitally or through the contact center.

entries.title: Make a Payment
entries.content: How can I pay my electricity bill? You can: Use Self Assist automated payment, Speak to an agent, Use available online payment options. What payment methods are accepted? Common payment methods include: Credit/debit card, Bank transfer, Online payment systems. Can I set up a payment plan? Yes. Speak with an agent to discuss available payment arrangement options. What happens if I miss a payment? Late payments may result in late fees or service disconnection if unpaid. How can I check my current bill amount? Use Self Assist to hear your balance or select Agent Assist for detailed billing support. Can I get a copy of my bill? Yes. An agent can provide billing details or resend your statement if available.

entries.title: Submit Meter Reading
entries.content: How do I submit my meter reading? Select the "Submit Meter Reading" option and provide the reading from your meter. When should I submit my meter reading? Submit your reading on or before your scheduled meter reading date. Where can I find my meter reading? Your meter reading is displayed on your electricity meter, typically located outside your property. What happens if I don't submit my meter reading? Your bill may be estimated based on previous usage. Can I correct a submitted meter reading? Yes. Contact an agent as soon as possible to correct the information. Why is my bill higher after submitting a meter reading? A higher bill may reflect: Increased electricity usage, Previous estimated readings being adjusted, Seasonal consumption changes.
